scope: Native completed Windows Move Undo after actual owned NTFS VHD detach, fresh-process retry and identity-checked reconnect. This checkpoint adds verification and QA controls; production behavior is unchanged.

verification.scenarios: Same-volume Replace on the secondary drive and cross-volume Replace, each for a regular file, directory tree and raw symbolic link; six completed Undos
verification.offline: A distinct ordinary-user process starts after confirmed VHD detach and drive absence, discovers six completions, admits local-registry-only recovery, retries canonical/controller IDs and bound/unbound cross-volume receipts, and performs an unrelated Move/Undo
verification.reconnect: The owned disk/volume IDs and owner token match on reconnect; a third distinct process compares saved registry/payload bytes and native identities, raw link targets, later edits, named streams and unknown private files before removing the fixture
verification.failure_paths: A deliberate preparation panic removes its uncommitted owned directories; a missing verification marker makes cleanup fail after removing the identity-admitted fixture. The negative test catches these expected failures and asserts both roots are absent; its stderr intentionally contains the caught panic messages.
strict_checks: Final Windows ottrin-platform all-target Clippy with warnings denied; clippy-platform.log
verification.prior_ui_acceptance: The prior checkpoint windows-move-completion-current retains 12 native UI checks and 395 Linux UI tests; they were not rerun for this Windows-only fixture/controller change
excluded: Renamed unfinished operations and retained forward histories before Undo

qa_changes: Explicit prepare/verify/cleanup/failure_teardown stages excluded from the ordinary Move suite
Native runner records actual child process IDs and start/finish UTC timestamps
Existing owned-volume controller supports guarded detach and attach without deleting or reformatting the image
Cleanup observes actual attachment state before reconnecting, rather than relying on an earlier intent flag

cleanup.retained_guest: Off, persistent domain unchanged, original user config and installation hashes unchanged
